row.title: A task left in sequence
row.body: The two objects were set out in working order, though the note of completion is missing.
row.rival_reading: The set could be left during a normal repair, and an unmarked checklist can be simple haste.
row.gloss: A prepared pair is left without a clear account of why it was needed.
